gaps.title: Missing Strain Management API
gaps.jtbd: When operating the archive, I want to create and manage isolated strains, so that they can be subject to the access control rules.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authorized user, When they send a request to add or modify a strain, Then the system should save the strain to the database with the provided access rules.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: A system enforcing access control on isolated strains must provide CRUD endpoints to manage them.
